notes:
Summary: DevQuasar is building a VS Code extension (marketplace/enterprise) that provides streaming inline completions and context-aware code actions. They prioritize low token-to-token latency for a fluid typing experience and workspace-level model pinning so customers can lock to vetted model versions.

Key quotes: "If suggestions feel laggy developers turn them off — we need sub-100ms perceived latency" — CTO. "Must be able to pin model per repo/workspace and fall back to smaller model on offline/bandwidth constrained machines" — Lead PM.

Technical requirements / priorities:
- Streaming completion with partial-token streaming to VS Code extension host (incremental render).
- Inline suggestions and code actions (quick-fixes) with trace IDs for debugging.
- Model/version pinning per workspace and per-team rollout controls.
- Rate-limits: per-seat + org-wide quotas; soft-throttle behavior preferred (no 429 on short bursts).
- Security: SSO/SAML, SCIM for provisioning later, audit logs, KMS integration for secrets, and EU data residency for a subset of enterprise customers.
- Fallbacks: route to cheaper quantized variants when Dedicated capacity exhausted; automatic degrade to non-streaming batch mode if network poor.

POC plan and acceptance criteria (from kickoff):
- Initial POC (2 weeks): integrate Redwood hosted API streaming into their VS Code extension sample; measure p95 token latency from keystroke->render; target p95 < 120ms.
- Security review (in-parallel): submit questionnaire -> expect SOC2 + SAML docs; need audit log sample.
- Load test: 200 concurrent active seats with per-seat burst allowance; measure end-to-end tail latency and rate-limit behavior.
- Quality gate: developer experience score >= 4/5 from internal dev panel (latency + relevance).

Recent activity (timeline):
- 2026-02-12: Intro call (Ava M.). CT0 demo: product and vision, initial fit confirmed.
- 2026-02-19: Technical kickoff (ff_20260219_devquasar_kickoff) — agreed on POC scope.
- 2026-02-24: Security questionnaire submitted to Redwood (drive link).
- 2026-03-01: POC started — dev branch integrating streaming API + local extension harness.
- 2026-03-05: Early demo to engineering team — generally positive; slower on large file context (>2000 tokens).
- 2026-03-08: Redwood provided suggested batching/kv-cache config (Optimize suggestions), Marcus oncall for infra notes.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood SE to provide sample streaming SDK snippet for VS Code extension host (action: Marcus).
- DevQuasar to provide SAML metadata & list of enterprise pilot orgs for residency mapping.
- Schedule performance deep-dive week of 2026-03-15.

Open blockers and risks:
- Need SAML metadata + IdP test tenant (blocks full security sign-off).
- Perceived latency still above target in large-file scenarios; may need prefix/KV cache configuration or model/kernel tuning on runtime.
- Legal on data residency and retention clauses for EU pilot orgs.

Misc:
- Pricing sensitivity: prefer committed reserved capacity if unit economics < $0.0006/token for generation-heavy workflows.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) after initial POC.
